head: working-tree
subject: gRPC xDS bootstrap server feature wiring
change: runtime.Options.applyServerFeatures copies the selected bootstrap server's four feature booleans into the controller options: ignore_resource_deletion, fail_on_data_errors, trusted_xds_server and resource_timer_is_transient_error. The helper makes the documented bootstrap-to-runtime flow explicit and avoids silently dropping a security-relevant feature such as trusted_xds_server.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/runtime/constructor_tests.zig parses a bootstrap document whose server_features name all four flags and checks that applyServerFeatures sets each runtime option.

focused_gate.command: zig build test-lib -Dtest-filter='bootstrap server features' -Dtest-filter='xDS runtime' -Dtest-filter='bootstrap' --summary all

notes: ControlPlane.server() returns the selected bootstrap server. The controller keeps the options it was created with, so a failover to a server with a different feature set requires the caller to recreate the controller or keep its caller-owned options in sync.
